thread:
Alex: quick heads-up — planning v0.15 bumps across api / runtime / console / sdk. Target cutoff: Fri 09:00 PT. Can owners confirm no blocking changes?
Sophia: noted. runtime PR #472 is open, need a perf run and a small test fix. will ping when ready.
Mohit: api PR #183 is ready for review, non-breaking header addition. @Rachel can you check the auth bits?
Rachel: will review in a bit, should be quick. do we need a compatibility note for clients?
Sophia: yes, I'll add a line to the runtime compatibility matrix for kv-cache subtle change. pushing commit shortly.
Sam: SDK side: drafted minor bumps and changelog entries for node/py. will open PRs later today.
Alex: two asks: (1) each PR needs a short changelog bullet in the description, (2) add a summary entry in release-notes/0.15.md before cutoff.
Mohit: adding changelog now and linking to #183.
release-bot: CI preflight started for v0.15 — pipelines queued.
release-bot: ci/runtime-integration — failed: test-kvcache-evict (flaky). label: flaky.
Sophia: investigating flaky test, rerunning with -p to capture logs.
Alex: if the flaky blocks canary, we will still cut but mark as known-issue in release notes and add mitigation. keep us posted.
Rachel: review done, left 2 comments on header parsing. Mohit, can you address before cutoff?
Mohit: yep, will patch in ~40m.
Sam: opened SDK PRs: node #88, py #89. Both reference api #183. Should we gate SDK merges on api merge?
Alex: merge order: runtime -> api -> sdk -> console. runtime must be canaried first.
Sophia: canary plan: deploy runtime to dedicated-canary (3 nodes) with 5% traffic, monitor latency/errors for 30m.
release-bot: canary deploy scheduled: 2025-11-06T15:30:00Z.
Alex: reminder: cutoff Fri 09:00 PT; after that only critical fixes. Ping this thread when your PRs are merged so I can update the release tracker. :thumbsup:
Sophia: quick paste of checklist to keep in thread:
```
Release checklist:
- bump versions across repos (api/runtime/console/sdk)
- add changelog bullets to PRs
- run canary (runtime) + monitor 30m
- merge in order: runtime -> api -> sdk -> console
- tag release and update release-notes/0.15.md
- post-release smoke tests
```
Mohit: will update #183 and link the changelog.
Rachel: once Mohit pushes, I can approve and merge.
Sam: will hold SDK merges until api is merged. thanks.
Alex: perfect. small ask — if anyone sees an edge-case break during canary, drop a short post here with logs and the label `known-issue` so we capture it in notes.
Sophia: agreed. I'll post a short canary dashboard link when it's live.
release-bot: all merged status checks will be posted here automatically.
Alex: thanks all — let's keep this tight over the next 48h.
